need.label: Americans with chronic pain every day
need.scope_note: Chronic pain is cross-specialty and this is not a count of all people with neurological disorders.

funding.scope_note: Lead-institute proxy; neurological research is also funded through other NIH institutes and programs.

digital_leverage.basis: Strong imaging, electrophysiology, longitudinal monitoring, EHR, and remote-assessment opportunities; fragmented phenotypes and specialist access remain constraints.

strategy.labor: Use tools and care models to extend scarce specialist time across triage, follow-up, rehabilitation, monitoring, and referral coordination.
strategy.applications: Favor longitudinal symptom tracking, stroke and epilepsy pathways, neurodiagnostic workflow, rehabilitation support, and decision support tied to measurable outcomes.
strategy.group: Convene neurologists with rehabilitation, imaging, digital-health, disability, caregiver, and community organizations rather than treating neurology as a single-department topic.
